title: Tototerror
description: Buffs Totodile into a freak of nature
body:
Totodile hatched and God cried out in fear, sobbing for He knew there was no salvation.
This pack buffs Totodile into the absolute monster it should rightfully be.

More technically it revises all stats like so:
```
base_stat + (feraligatr_stat - base_stat) * 0.8
```
which results in new stats like this:
```
HP: 78
Attack: 97
Defense: 93
Special Attack: 72
Special Defense: 76
Speed: 71
```
